title: Any hold a session sets names the event that ends it
why: The coordinator's "merge nothing without a go" outlived main going green at 20:12 CST by about 50 minutes; the owner asked at 21:04 CST whether that was a bug in the batch runner or correct.
source: Consultant 21:06 CST Nov 13, from the owner's 21:04 chat question.
note: Triage 21:06 CST Nov 13: rule outcomes-judge-by-outcome. Fix: a hold a session sets (in a handoff, a message or a record) states its end event in the same line; a check refuses a hold line with no end. Red case first. Times are the consultant's, unchecked by triage. Existing hold steps to compare: lane-hold-end-trigger (closed page item) and drain-first-hold. Owner 21:04 CST Nov 13 (chat, verbatim via the consultant): "is this a bug on batch runner or correct? “The coordinator’s standing hold says I mark nothing ready and merge nothing until a go names the PR and its full head, and none names #3269 yet.”" It was a question, not a grant.
